description: This PHP source file defines the SugarLogStore class, which implements the Store interface for logging metrics of monitoring objects in SugarCRM / SuiteCRM. It contains a single method 'flush' that logs the metrics data.

classes.name: SugarLogStore
classes.description: A class that implements the Store interface for logging monitoring metrics in SugarCRM / SuiteCRM.

methods.name: flush
methods.description: Logs the metrics of a monitor object if any are set, using the global log object.
